items.headline: Philippine fast-food giant Jollibee picks Hong Kong over New York for spin-off’s listing
items.detail: The parent company of Philippine fast-food giant Jollibee plans to spin off and list its international operations in Hong Kong instead of New York in a strong endorsement of the city’s initial public offering (IPO) diversification efforts.
